steps.text: Plug the Lock Controller in within five feet of the door lock; use an extension cord if necessary.
Open the door lock cover and tap its S button.
Tap the SET button on the Lock Controller.
steps.expect: Door lock double-beeps; status LED turns red

steps.text: After setup, place the Lock Controller up to 30 feet from the door lock.

notes: It converts Insteon commands to the MiLock's one-way RF, so an Insteon system can't confirm that the lock received a command.
Tap the SET button to toggle the lock.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the status LED starts blinking.

notes: This is the step the manual gives when adding the Lock Controller to a Hub 2245.

Manual linking as a responder: tap the SET button to set the lock to locked or unlocked, press and hold the controller's SET button until it beeps, then press and hold the Lock Controller's SET button until it double-beeps.
The manual advises against manual linking when a central controller such as a Hub is used.

steps.text: After putting the controller in unlinking mode, press and hold the SET button until the Lock Controller double-beeps.

notes: Unlinking mode on most controllers: press and hold the controller's SET button until it beeps, then again until it beeps and its status LED blinks red.
